title: Notification fetch in NotificationContext was a complete no-op
dispatch() doesn't check queue.add() return — silent drop when Redis is down
fixEvidence: `notification.service.js`: try/catch around queue.add + fallback direct Socket.IO emit

title: Internal endpoint fails closed (503) when token unset — inconsistent with other internal routes
Socket.IO static token — Keycloak expiry kills real-time notifications without page reload
fixEvidence: `NotificationContext.js`: token-watch useEffect updates `socket.auth` and reconnects; removed force-disconnect on jwt error

title: Socket.IO room `user:{id}` — cross-org notification leakage for multi-org users
fixEvidence: `socket.js`: join `org:{orgId}:user:{userId}` room; `notification.worker.js` + `notification.service.js`: emit to org-scoped room

title: NotificationMenu click-to-navigate uses `notification.link` but dispatch field is `navigateTo` — zero clicks navigate
description:
**File:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/notifications/NotificationMenu.js` (and `NotificationMenu_chakra.js`)
**Line:** 33
**Root Cause:** `handleNotificationClick` checks `notification.link` for navigation, but `dispatch()` populates `navigateTo`, not `link`. The field `link` is never set by the backend or socket emit.
**Impact:** Every notification click never navigates. The `markAsRead` fires correctly but the navigation step is silently skipped.
**Fix:** Replace `notification.link` with `notification.navigateTo` in both menu components.
